title: [Salty's Services, Warehouse]
description: A broad kelp-lined curtain opens on a massive warehouse facility.  Sturdy-looking wooden beams reinforced with iron bars hold the towering structure in place over a domed roof lit by wide metal braziers.  A wide path leads forward and is flanked by small standalone buildings within the facility, each in a varying state of repair.  Battered-looking hovels reside alongside well-maintained storefronts.  Vendors and potential customers alike walk the hall, perusing the options.
